help.title: Field guide
help.body: Hold and drag the left mouse button to select a group. Alt + left-click adds a settler to the selection. Select settlers with the left mouse button. Right-click to move or gather. Page Up and Page Down switch layers; Use passage sends selected settlers through a known shaft. H, F and B place buildings. F1 hides or restores the entire HUD. F5 saves and F9 loads local games. Right-click to replace the queue. Shift + right-click adds the next order.
save.climate_incompatible: This save predates weather or uses a different version of its rules. The file is retained; new worlds use a separate save folder.

profession.title: Profession and skills
profession.label: Profession
profession.priority_hint: Farming, construction and hauling use automatic work. Wood, stone and wild food need a manual order.
profession.choose_hint: Select a known resource or building on the map. Right-click or Escape cancels.
profession.skill_hint: Point to a skill or focus it with the keyboard to see its effect. Experience is permanent; lost practice recovers during useful work.

manual.title: Orders and control
manual.hint: Orders apply to every selected settler. Right-click to assign; Shift + right-click to append (up to 8 per person).
manual.gather.1: One delivery: 3 wood or 2 stone / food
manual.queue_title: Orders of the first selected settler
manual.policy_hint: Each settler delivers their share to storage, then returns to daily life after the queue ends. Professions do not start extraction.
manual.release_hint: Release applies to the selection and returns settlers to their assigned work after safe delivery. Transfer keeps their orders, cargo and skills.
manual.control_failure.2: Only the current controller can do this

resource.future: These resources are not available for production yet.
bridge.help: Bridge: 12 wood + 4 stone per section. Start at a shore; extend from a completed section. Right click exits placement.
hud.temperature_preview: Temperature: display only; does not affect gameplay.
settlement.title: Settlement decisions
settlement.night_hint: Work until dawn. Charged once per night. No fatigue or next-day work penalty.
settlement.recruit_hint: One young settler arrives after 2 minutes and becomes an adult 3 minutes later. Times at 1×; 2×/4× accelerates both timers.
settlement.enterprises: Day: 06:00–18:00. Ordinary work rests at night; already carried cargo finishes delivery.

settlement.stale: The decision changed. Check the updated state.
settlement.night_unavailable: It is daytime or this night shift is already allowed.
settlement.youth_unavailable: Settler is adult, unavailable or already allowed to work.

wilderness.busy: Мешканці зайняті іншим дорученням чи доставкою.
wilderness.youth: В експедицію можна відправити дорослих мешканців.
wilderness.night: Ніч: загін повертається з наявним вантажем.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.hint: The same team number means one shared settlement. Changing teams resets readiness.
lobby.waiting: Waiting for the game to start.
lobby.need_players: At least two players are required.
lobby.host_only: Only the room host can do this.
lobby.rules: New players join the host's team by default and share one settlement. Different teams remain independent. Only the host changes speed or resumes after a pause.
online.help: New players share the host's team and settlement. For a different settlement, change team in the lobby. Everyone must use the same game version.
network.connect_timeout: The host did not reply. Check the address and that the room is running. Across different networks, use a shared VPN or a public IP with UDP port forwarding.

inspector.hint.no_order: Choose a recipe, enter the number of batches, select a worker or automatic selection, then start the order.
inspector.hint.no_worker: Free an adult resident, then start the order again. Stop an unavailable worker's old order first.
inspector.hint.materials: Supply the listed ingredients to the camp or stockpile. The worker will collect them automatically.
inspector.hint.delivery: Materials are being collected or delivered. Wait for the worker to finish carrying them.

inspector.hint.working: Work is in progress. The finished product will still need delivery.
inspector.hint.output: The batch is made and is being carried to storage. Wait for the goods to arrive before using them.
inspector.hint.complete: The order has ended. You can start another order. Available stocks are shown in the stock panel.
inspector.hint.cancelled: The order stopped. Materials returned to the ground require hauling before reuse.
inspector.hint.output_ground: The product was made but not delivered. Restore access to storage and haul the goods from the ground.
inspector.hint.night: Rest until morning. Work resumes during the day.
inspector.hint.storage_full: Free space in an accessible camp or stockpile, or build another stockpile. Finished work is waiting for a delivery destination.
inspector.hint.unreachable: Check access to the building and storage. Open a route or complete a bridge; the worker will retry.

inspector.hint.unavailable: This work is currently unavailable. Check the worker and the building.
inspector.hint.danger: The worker cannot work while under attack. Move them to safety.
inspector.hint.youth: Wait until the resident becomes an adult.
